codelines.evidence: Opened src/fares.ts and test/fares.test.ts. MOCK3-1 is confirmed here: fareFor (src/fares.ts:10) uses `if (rider.age > 65)` to gate the concession fare, so a rider aged exactly 65 falls through to the adult fare of 350 cents (line 12) instead of the concession fare of 175. The JSDoc comment on line 7 states 'Riders aged 65 AND OVER pay the concession fare,' confirming the boundary is wrong. The test file (test/fares.test.ts) only covers age 70 (well past the boundary) and never tests age 65 exactly, which is why the bug went unnoticed. fareFor is called by totalFor (src/fares.ts:15) and by the tests.

Opened src/schedule.ts and test/schedule.test.ts. MOCK3-2 is confirmed here: formatStops (src/schedule.ts:4) iterates `for (let i = 0; i < stops.length - 1; i++)`, which skips the final stop. A three-stop line renders only two stops. totalMinutes (src/schedule.ts:12) reads `stops[stops.length - 1].minutes` directly, so it reports the correct journey length — explaining why the omission went unnoticed. The test file (test/schedule.test.ts) only checks that the output contains '->' and contains 'Union' (the first stop); it never asserts the last stop appears, so the bug is not caught.

recommendedInvestigators.focus: Confirm the fare boundary logic in src/fares.ts and verify whether any other code paths or callers of fareFor/totalFor depend on the current (incorrect) boundary behavior. Check whether the test suite has other age-boundary cases that need updating.
recommendedInvestigators.why: The bug is a single-operator boundary error (`>` instead of `>=`) in fareFor, but the investigator should confirm no downstream logic assumes the current behavior and identify what test coverage for age 65 should look like.

recommendedInvestigators.focus: Confirm the loop bound in formatStops and check whether any caller of formatStops or totalMinutes compensates for the missing last stop. Review the test suite for assertions that should include the final stop.
recommendedInvestigators.why: The bug is an off-by-one loop bound (`< stops.length - 1`), but the investigator should verify no caller works around the omission and determine what test coverage for the last stop is needed.

recommendedWriters.focus: Write a one-line boundary fix in src/fares.ts and add a test case for age exactly 65 in test/fares.test.ts. Must be able to run vitest to verify.
recommendedWriters.why: The fix is a single operator change in fareFor, and the test suite needs a new boundary case to prevent regression. The codeline uses vitest and typescript.

recommendedWriters.focus: Write a loop-bound fix in src/schedule.ts so formatStops includes the last stop, and add a test asserting the final stop appears in the output. Must be able to run vitest to verify.
recommendedWriters.why: The fix is a loop bound change in formatStops, and the test suite needs an assertion covering the last stop. The codeline uses vitest and typescript.
